phase_name: Reproduce the partition mechanically before editing anything

objectives.description: Write standalone scratch classifier deriving six-command route table
Print derived route table and eyeball against CLAUDE.md mapping
Emit sorted bucket path lists, confirm counts sum to baseline
Diff redundant/legitimate lists against report tables, reconcile divergence
objectives.note: Found and fixed a jq bug (index(.) rebinds '.' when piped through a variable, a known jq footgun) in the scratch classifier; after the fix the partition (36/13/0) is byte-identical to the report's tables.

objectives.description: Attribute every redundant path to its owning index-entries.json
objectives.note: All 36 redundant paths confirmed owned exclusively by agent-system/extensions/core/index-entries.json; 0 in any other extension.

approaches_tried.approach: jq set-difference partition using `$direct | index(.)` for direct-command membership test
approaches_tried.reason: jq rebinds `.` to the piped-in array inside index()'s argument, so index(.) does not test membership of the original current value; produced 0 redundant / 49 legitimate instead of the expected 36/13. Fixed by using `$direct | any(. == $c)` with an explicitly bound variable instead.
